releases.name: Wrap House Simulator
releases.summary: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

releases.name: PARCEL INSPECTION SIMULATOR
releases.summary:
Inspect every parcel and keep the deliveries moving.

Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly.

From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

Key Features:
• Receive and Sort Parcels – Manage the full parcel workflow: accept shipments, sort them correctly, and prepare them for the next stage of processing.
• Inspect Documents Carefully – Verify sender and recipient information, identify incorrect data, and prevent costly mistakes.
• Multiple Inspection Methods – Use different tools and checking methods to ensure every parcel meets the correct requirements.
• Upgrade Your Workspace – Expand your inspection area, upgrade equipment, and improve your parcel processing system.
• Increasing Workload – Handle more packages and more complex tasks as operations grow busier and more demanding.
• Build an Efficient Operation – Start with a small inspection point and develop it into a well-organized parcel management system.

releases.name: Rhythm Roll
releases.summary: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

releases.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
releases.summary:
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

Kill bugs, upgrade your gear, and delve ever deeper into the lethal caves of Hoxxes. Collect and assemble a devastating array of guns, unleash hell upon wave after wave of alien monsters in fast and frenetic combat, and tunnel your way to collect precious riches from deep within the cave walls. Each mission is unique, using procedural cave generation and enemy waves, just as you've come to know from Deep Rock Galactic.

releases.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
releases.summary:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places.

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op.

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas.

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.

releases.name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
releases.summary: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

releases.name: Sugar Rush Rescue
releases.summary:
A tasty, retro co-op adventure.

When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.

releases.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
releases.summary: The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

releases.name: Solitaire Dreams - Lofi Cozy Coffee
releases.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a relaxing lofi twist. Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world.

This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

releases.name: Rainbow Islands Console Selection
releases.summary:
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

releases.name: Neatly Organized
releases.summary:
A colorful, chaotic, and ridiculously satisfying organizing puzzle!

Things are everywhere. The bathroom is a disaster, the desk has disappeared under a mountain of stuff, and the kitchen? Let's not even talk about it.

The mission is simple: pick it up, figure out where it belongs, and make the chaos disappear!

Sort toiletries, stationery, plants, kitchenware, toys, and all kinds of wonderfully weird household items across a variety of colorful rooms. Find the right spot for every object and watch each messy space transform into a perfectly organized one.

With bold cartoon visuals, playful details, and a lighthearted sense of humor, every room is packed with little surprises to discover. No timers. No pressure. Just pure organizing satisfaction.

Whether you love cozy games, satisfying puzzles, or simply enjoy turning complete chaos into glorious order, Neatly Organized is ready to make a mess of your day - and then help you clean it up.

releases.name: WordBuzz 6
releases.summary:
Build words, score points, and master the hive.

WordBuzz 6 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you eight letters: seven outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. Every word must include the center letter.

Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all eight letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points.

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience.

Increase your score to climb the global rankings, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master.

WordBuzz 6 uses modern Oxford English dictionary.

Features
• Play through 5,000 all-new word puzzle levels
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all eight letters
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off
• Skip to the next level after 24 hours
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode

releases.name: Cursed Images: What You Shouldn't See
releases.summary:
Could you stay calm when you find what shouldn't be there?

What if an ordinary photo captured something that was never meant to be seen?

Everyday moments can hide an unsettling secret. A casual snapshot may contain a presence, a detail, or a figure that simply does not belong.

Take a close look at each image and search for the one disturbing spot hidden within it.

・Study the photo carefully
・Notice anything that feels out of place
・Click the spot that reveals the answer

The moment you recognize the strange detail, the real shock begins. Can you handle what you find without looking away?

Perfect for fans of paranormal photos, mysteries, urban legends, scary stories, and anyone who enjoys a tense visual puzzle. Play alone for a creepy challenge, or gather friends for a thrilling party session.

If you scare easily, keep the lights on—and take care of any late-night preparations before you play!

releases.name: Me in a Dress!? Femboy Maid: Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
Can you spot the secret?

“I’m working as a maid… but it’s a secret.”

Follow the everyday life of a sweet, slightly clumsy boy who dresses up as a maid and does his best to serve others. Each illustration contains one hidden difference on the right half.

releases.name: Solitaire Realms - Vampires & Werewolves
releases.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a gothic twist. Play classic Solitaire in a world of vampires and werewolves.

This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a dark, atmospheric presentation filled with rich colors, moonlit scenes, and creatures of the night.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include striking vampire and werewolf card skins, breathtaking backgrounds inspired by gothic castles, moonlit forests, and candlelit crypts, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer deep crimson tones, detailed gothic illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

releases.name: Break Your Limits! Ultimate Memory Quiz
releases.summary:
Can you conquer memory’s toughest quiz?

How much can you really remember when every detail counts?

A complex illustration packed with items appears before you. Study its placement, colors, shapes, and tiny details, then commit as much as possible to memory.

Once the image is covered, only your memory can help you. Questions about subtle details are waiting to test how carefully you observed.

The rules are simple.
• Study the illustration closely
• Memorize as much information as you can
• Answer a four-choice quiz using memory alone

From mysterious rooms and unusual research facilities to floating worlds and snowy mountain bases, a variety of imaginative scenes await. Put your observation and memory skills to the test as you try to recall every detail.

Remembering only the most noticeable objects may not be enough. Look closely, trust your memory, and take on every challenge.

Can your memory keep up with these demanding questions?

releases.name: Super Shooting Gallery Battle
releases.summary: It's a shooting gallery like you've never seen it before! Aim, fire, and battle it out in wild shooting gallery action!

releases.name: Zodiac 2: Aggres
releases.summary:
A 1986 classic is reborn. Dive into a gripping sci-fi mystery to find your missing father and the "Blue Crystal" alongside your sharp-tongued partner, Mary.

Released in 1986 by Riverhill Soft, this title is a profound sci-fi mystery that follows a young man—the son of a space archaeologist—and his nagging, antique-loving robot partner, "Amaroid Marie," as they track down the mystery of his missing father.

The story begins five years after the protagonist's father, Dr. Dumas, a leading authority in space archaeology, vanished during a research expedition. Refusing to believe he is gone, the protagonist makes a meager living as a freight hauler while scouring the far reaches of the galaxy for clues alongside Marie.

Though they once survived a life-or-death struggle on a forbidden, dormant planet while chasing the energy of the "Blue Crystal"—a mysterious artifact fragment once embedded in his father’s right arm—the definitive truth remains out of reach, leaving the protagonist in a state of growing frustration.

This stalemate is shattered by a single radio news broadcast. Jason Cannack, a man who served as the doctor’s assistant but fled with stolen research immediately after the disappearance, has been appointed as the new director of the City Library. Sensing a breakthrough, the protagonist’s intuition turns to certainty: "He must know my father's secret."

releases.name: The Sound of Spring Is Like You
releases.summary:
Haru no Oto hamarude Kun Ninite te begins when the protagonist, Aihara Airi, who is struggling with a period of feeling lost on a dark night, happens to hear Ao's singing voice and the story of the two begins. 

Set in a Japanese girls' school, this is a kinetic Yuri novel that depicts the process of growth and love as two girls meet, find the path they want to follow through each other, and take one step at a time.

releases.name: Aha... Oh No.
releases.summary:
When the truth clicks, the chills begin.

What looked ordinary a moment ago may not stay that way.

You know that feeling: something seems off, but you cannot quite say what it is. At first, noticing the change feels satisfying. Then the meaning sinks in—and a chill runs down your spine.

This is an Aha-style visual horror puzzle built around subtle changes in everyday photographs. Watch closely as a familiar scene slowly becomes something else. The further you go, the more unsettling the world around you may feel.

How to play:
・Watch the photograph carefully
・Notice the area that gradually changes
・Tap the spot where the change occurred

No complicated controls—just your eyes, your instincts, and the courage to keep looking. Each discovery brings a small rush of insight, followed by the uneasy feeling that you may have been better off not knowing.

Perfect for a quick scare during a spare moment, whether you enjoy visual puzzles, eerie games, or that irresistible “just one more” feeling. Test your powers of observation and see if you can handle what you uncover.

releases.name: Lazy Day Girlfriend Observation Puzzle
releases.summary:
Can you complete her lazy day?

What does a perfect day off look like?

A girlfriend's laid-back weekend photos have been split into puzzle pieces! Restore each picture by rotating and returning the pieces to their proper positions in this simple, relaxing photo puzzle.

Take your time with scenes of relaxing at home, unwinding on the bed, or taking a quiet break with a drink in hand. Enjoy each unhurried moment as the picture gradually comes together.

releases.name: Manairons
releases.summary: The Manairons are back… and this time, they’re not staying quiet! Manairons is a 3D action platformer game set in the Pyrenees, where ancient legends mix with smoking factories, mischievous magic, and quirky little creatures. You are Nai, a manairó who has just awakened from centuries locked in the ""canut"", a magical artifact as old as it is suspicious. A witch frees you (very timely, indeed) and gives you a mission: recover the "canut" and stop the chaos it’s causing. The culprit? Llorenç, a landowner with zero charisma and a lot of machines. He’s used the power of the manairons to industrialize the peaceful village of Vilamont. Shops are closed, people are hiding at home, and your fellow manairons are working as if there’s no tomorrow… This is not what the legends said! But Nai isn’t going to sit back. With the help of ancient magical melodies (and a few poorly played notes), you’ll control your fellow manairons, solve puzzles that’ll make you scratch your head, and face your own kind who are working for Llorenç—all with the flute! Adventure, action, stressed-out little creatures, and more than a few hidden secrets await you in the mountains. And remember: when a manairó gets mad… it’s best to step aside. Key Features: - Businesses: Explore the most important businesses of Vilamont, each with its own style and unique challenges. - Magical Melodies: Learn and play different melodies to solve puzzles that will test your creativity and problem-solving skills. - Flute Combat:Face off against other Manairons with your flute. Knock them out or send them to sleep! - Unique Bosses: Defeat the bosses of each zone to progress in the story and free the Manairons. - Tons of Secrets: Each business hides secrets waiting to be uncovered. Are you brave enough to find them all?

releases.name: Heroic Songs: The Remix
releases.summary:
An idol x city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

The adventure begins in a blank, open field beneath the World Tree. From roads to buildings, you’ll place a wide variety of structures to gather resources and grow your city into a thriving sanctuary.

As the Fanctuary develops, you’ll attract more fans, earn Likes, and unlock new concerts. You can even build stages where your idols will perform in front of cheering crowds!
